about: Which riven stat combinations buyers look for, per weapon (warframe.market slugs). A lone stat in need is required; pick is the pool the other wanted stats come from; harmless lists the negatives that do not hurt. Started from the good rolls for selling guide by 44bananas, update 44.1.2 (see ATTRIBUTIONS.md). Change it through a pull request: CONTRIBUTING.md, Riven roll guide.
